title: Compensated root-water-uptake source/order/owner authority
protocol: RECONCILE -> SOURCE AUTHORITY -> CORROBORATING TRACE -> ORDER/STATE/MASS CLASSIFY -> MIGRATION SLICING -> QUALIFY -> CLOSE OR BLOCK
scope: compensation owner relative to the existing nodewise root-water sink owner
ordering relative to pre-compensation drought/wetness/salinity/frost stress reductions
non_goals: inventing compensation equations from later artifacts
oxygen, salinity or frost production admission
fail_closed_rule: Later rootextraction artifacts and historical contracts may corroborate owner/order boundaries but are not the exact B1.11 equation oracle. If exact B1.11 source bytes remain unavailable, equation-level and persistent-state claims remain held.
pass_conditions: single accepted nodewise root-sink mass owner preserved
compensation classified as a root-uptake composition/modification surface rather than a second mass owner
exact B1.11 source identity pinned and later-artifact mismatch explicitly classified
persistent state/restart not inferred without exact source
retry cannot compound scaling from rejected trial output
Jarvis/Walsum and multi-stressor dependencies sliced explicitly
